description: This Java class 'HL7InArchive' represents a processed HL7 message archive within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It extends HL7QueueItem and includes fields and methods related to storing and accessing archived HL7 messages, including their ID, message state, source, and data load status.

classes.name: HL7InArchive
classes.description: Represents a successfully processed HL7 message archive, extending HL7QueueItem with additional fields for archive ID, message state, and load status.

methods.name: HL7InArchive
methods.description: Convenience constructor that initializes the archive object from an existing HL7InQueue object.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveId
methods.description: Returns the archive ID for the HL7 message.

methods.name: setHL7InArchiveId
methods.description: Sets the archive ID for the HL7 message.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides parent method to return the archive ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides parent method to set the archive ID.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Indicates whether the HL7 data has been loaded from the filesystem.

methods.name: setLoaded
methods.description: Sets the loaded status for HL7 data.
